entries.0dacadec8d7ce7fd: This is a category of businesses not included in the reportable segments. It operates a mutual aid society for weddings and funerals (Members System), small-amount short-term insurance, house cleaning, and research on wedding and funeral-related matters. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, demand for cleaning and household goods clearance in house cleaning increased, and revenue was ¥540 million, up 4.0% from the previous year. It is handled by Sun Life Members Co., Ltd., Sun Ceremony Co., Ltd., Moshian Small-Amount Short-Term Insurance Co., Ltd., Total Life Support Research Institute Co., Ltd., Skill Co., Ltd. and others.

entries.21c056a4315c6252: It is a business that operates home care services and paid nursing homes. It provides care planning services and day-service and short-stay care services, and operates care-type paid nursing homes and housing-type paid nursing homes. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, occupancy rates at its facilities and the number of service users increased, and in December 2025 it opened the day service facility "Emiz Shonan Hiratsuka" through a business acquisition. Revenue was ¥2,276 million, up 5.2% from the previous year. It is mainly handled by Sun Life Co., Ltd., The Sun Power Co., Ltd. and Clover Co., Ltd.

entries.726c2043ca610ec5: In the Ceremony Business it conducts funerals and memorial services, embalming, pet funerals and cemetery management, and operates Buddhist altar shops; in the Nursing Care Business it provides home-based nursing care services and operates paid nursing homes for the elderly; and in the Hotel Business it provides weddings, banquets and accommodation. Its other businesses include mutual aid societies, small-amount short-term insurance and house cleaning.

entries.7e988906e2921203: Toward its 100th anniversary in 2033, it has set out a 10-year initiative starting in 2023, “Sustain100 ～Toward a Sustainable Tomorrow～.” In the Ceremony Business it plans to expand its comprehensive end-of-life support business “Life Relief” and strategically open new funeral halls; in the Nursing Care Business it plans to secure nurses and care helpers, improve their working conditions, and expand its business areas through M&A. In its mutual aid society business, it plans to leverage its member customer base while also working to expand its customer base beyond members through measures such as a free registration system.
entries.84e1ecbc3c82a06b: In the fiscal year ended March 2026, the number of funerals held decreased due to fewer deaths in its main areas, while net sales rose in the Nursing Care Business on higher facility occupancy rates and an increase in the number of service uses, and in the Hotel Business on an increase in the number of weddings held, and consolidated net sales exceeded the previous year.
entries.8af9dcc52f051e79: Net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥619 million, down 25.8% from the previous year.
entries.8eff31ede88efd01: It is a business centered on conducting funerals and memorial services. In addition to operating funeral halls and memorial halls, it provides embalming (body preservation), pet funerals, cemetery management and operates Buddhist altar shops. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, it opened five Family Halls supporting family funerals in Kanagawa and Tokyo prefectures, and started "Life Relief," a service supporting all aspects of end-of-life preparation. Revenue was ¥10,212 million, up 0.1% from the previous year. The number of funerals decreased due to fewer deaths in its main areas, while natural burial, household goods clearance and inheritance-related real estate businesses increased. Sun Life Co., Ltd., a consolidated subsidiary, mainly handles it, with SEC Co., Ltd. handling embalming and Pet Ceremony Wavy Co., Ltd. handling pet funerals.
entries.902fdcc06afaaaeb: Regarding the environment surrounding the Ceremony Business, it states that the market environment has changed significantly due to a trend toward smaller funerals and growing preference for simplification centered on family funerals.

entries.a3506681d6007dac: A business that operates a hotel and a comprehensive wedding hall. In addition to wedding, banquet and accommodation services, it also operates an EC site and a photo studio. The main facilities are Hotel Sun Life Garden in Hiratsuka, Kanagawa Prefecture, and The Wings. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, the number of weddings held increased, and net sales were ¥1,120 million, an increase of 15.0% from the previous year. It is carried out by the consolidated subsidiary Sun Life Service Co., Ltd.

entries.ab0ac1f9944d72fe: Net sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥14,149 million, up 2.1% from the previous year. The Ceremony Business accounted for ¥10,212 million, the Nursing Care Business for ¥2,276 million, the Hotel Business for ¥1,120 million and Other Business for ¥540 million. The Hotel Business grew on an increase in the number of weddings held, and the Nursing Care Business grew on higher facility occupancy rates and an increase in the number of service uses. In the Ceremony Business, a decline in the number of funerals held was offset by growth in natural burials and household goods clearance services.
